breakdown.description: The inward hole pressure is reversed to an outward traction by changing the sign relative to the solid normal
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to correct the sign convention for the inward pressure. The ground truth specifies the correct formula for an inward pressure using an outward normal vector as `t = -p*n`. The generated specification repeated the user's error by stating `t = +p*n`, which represents an outward traction (tension), not an inward pressure.
